Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class DeviceConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.DeviceConfiguration
@Configuration(value="deviceWebConfiguration", proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties(DeviceRateLimitProperties.class) public class DeviceConfiguration extends Object
Installs the device authorization grant in the protocol chain. Nothing outside this feature is edited: the chain applies every ProtocolChainCustomizer bean, in order.

    • deviceProtocolChainCustomizer

      @Bean @Order(2) public ProtocolChainCustomizer deviceProtocolChainCustomizer(org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.client.RegisteredClientRepository registeredClients, org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.OAuth2AuthorizationService authorizationService, org.springframework.security.oauth2.server.authorization.settings.AuthorizationServerSettings serverSettings, DeviceVerificationRateLimiter rateLimiter, MfaAuthorizationManager authorizationManager, SecondFactorRequiredEntryPoint secondFactorEntryPoint, ReauthenticationEntryPoint reauthenticationEntryPoint)
      Declares the customizer that enables the device endpoints. It is applied after the multi-factor and step-up ones.
      Parameters:
      registeredClients - finds the clients of the devices.
      authorizationService - finds the device authorization of a user code.
      serverSettings - settings of the protocol endpoints, for the device authorization one.
      rateLimiter - limits the attempts.
      authorizationManager - applies the multi-factor policy.
      secondFactorEntryPoint - entry point of the second-factor page.
      reauthenticationEntryPoint - entry point that forces a new sign-in.
      Returns:
      the customizer.
